name: Student residence permit (§ 16b AufenthG)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires confirmed admission to a German university or a recognised preparatory program (Studienkolleg).

value.note: blocked account (Sperrkonto), €992/month, tied to the BAföG rate

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a blocked account (Sperrkonto) holding €11,904/year (€992/month, 2026 figure).
requirements.fix_path: Open and fund a blocked account with the required amount.
Arrange statutory or private German health insurance before applying.

outcome.duration_length: usually up to 2 years, renewable while enrolled

sources.title: Auswärtiges Amt - blocked account requirement for student visas

notes: Blocked account figure of €11,904/year (€992/month) is corroborated primarily via aggregator sites referencing the Auswärtiges Amt rather than a directly-fetched embassy Merkblatt — flagged honestly as a slightly weaker sourcing position than the Chancenkarte's €1,091/month figure, which was confirmed directly via arbeitsagentur.de. Recommend a priority re-check against a specific embassy Merkblatt before this route leaves any draft-equivalent status. Work rights: 140 full days or 280 half-days per year (raised from 120/240 on 1 March 2024), or roughly 20 hours/week during lecture periods — same precision gap as uk_student and de_chancenkarte, where the schema's coarse work_rights enum can't hold an hours/days figure; captured in notes only. This is the direct feeder into de_job_seeker_post_study, mirroring the UK's Student→Graduate structure and giving Germany its own version of the core Journey chain.
